text: design-review/SKILL.md tells a reviewer to ground every refutation at its file:line, and FindingRow carries severity, free text and a disposition — no citation. A compliant citation lands in the text blob, where the only reader is the vanish check comparing collapsed prose. Measured in a neighbouring project: a spec whose design rounds filed no rows at all ran thirteen rounds without a termination signal, while its code rounds filed thirty-seven cited rows and closed in ten. The instruction and the grammar are both shipped here and they do not meet. Not built: nothing reads a citation today, and a parser with no consumer is the shape this repository refuses. Build it when a consumer exists — citation-based identity for the vanish check, or a detector for the round where design findings stop citing the design
